summary: New York City, New York dashboard uses 200 discovered official/open sources and 53729 searchable records. Current-state layer markers include buildings/development, traffic/transport, environment, services, economy and utilities where discovered.

cards.label: Buildings & planning
cards.note: planning, parcels, buildings, zoning, heritage/current-state layers

cards.label: Traffic & transport
cards.note: road traffic, transit, collisions, permits and street-change layers

cards.label: Environment
cards.note: flood, air, trees, parks, noise, climate and land-cover layers

cards.label: Services & equity
cards.note: schools, safety, health, 311/public services and community infrastructure

cards.label: Economy/jobs

cards.label: Utilities/infra
